topic: be 动词与一般现在时
summary: 英语句子的「骨架」：be 动词（am/is/are）表示「是」；一般现在时表示经常性、习惯性的动作或客观事实。

rules.title: be 动词的三种形式：am / is / are
rules.detail: 口诀：我用 am，你用 are，is 跟着他她它；单数 is，复数 are。

rules.title: 一般现在时：主语是第三人称单数时，动词要加 -s / -es
rules.detail: he / she / it 或单个人名（Tom、my mother）作主语时，动词词尾加 s 或 es；以 s、x、ch、sh、o 结尾的动词加 es（go → goes，watch → watches）；以辅音字母+y 结尾，变 y 为 i 加 es（study → studies）。

examples.en: My mother watches TV every evening.
examples.zh: 我妈妈每天晚上看电视。

rules.title: 否定句与疑问句：借助 do / does
rules.detail: 主语三单时用 does（does 后动词要还原为原形！），其他人称用 do。否定：don't / doesn't + 动词原形；疑问：Do / Does + 主语 + 动词原形？

examples.en: Does he go to school by bus?

pitfalls: 三单忘加 s：❌ He like English. → ✓ He likes English.
does 后动词没还原：❌ Does she likes it? → ✓ Does she like it?
be 动词和行为动词混用：❌ He is go to school. → ✓ He goes to school.

rows.r: 表示此刻正在进行的动作

rows.l: I get up at six every day.

questions.stem: Tom ___ to school by bike every day.
questions.explain: Tom 是第三人称单数，every day 是一般现在时标志词，动词用三单形式 goes。

questions.stem: — ___ your parents often watch TV in the evening? — Yes, they do.
questions.explain: your parents 是复数，一般现在时的疑问句借助助动词 do；回答用 they do。

questions.stem: My sister and I ___ students of No. 1 Middle School.
questions.explain: My sister and I 是复数主语，be 动词用 are。

questions.stem: She ___ her homework after dinner every evening.
questions.explain: she 是第三人称单数，do homework 的 do 变 does。

questions.stem: Li Ming ___ (have) lunch at school every day.
questions.explain: have 是不规则变化：第三人称单数用 has（不是 haves）。
they 是复数，be 动词用 are。

questions.stem: My father ___ (not watch) TV on weekdays.
questions.explain: 第三人称单数否定用 doesn't + 动词原形 watch。

questions.stem: He like playing basketball after class.
questions.explain: he 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词 like 要加 s。

questions.stem: 我通常六点半起床。（翻译整句）
answer: I usually get up at six thirty.
I usually get up at half past six.
questions.explain: 「我」是第一人称，get up 用原形；usually 放在实义动词前。

questions.stem: Tom 不喜欢鸡蛋。（翻译整句）
questions.explain: 第三人称单数否定：doesn't + 动词原形 like；egg 用复数 eggs 表示泛指。
